GO requires failed STOP, positive lower bound and all three positive seed estimates. Missing safeguards yield INCONCLUSIVE, never automatic GO.

nodes.label: A21 screening enforcement and A36 historical run
nodes.norm_label: a21 screening enforcement and a36 historical run
nodes.summary: September 3 all eleven UniVec directories were absent despite A21; nine species had been aligned from unscreened originals. No junction-support outputs yet depended on them. UniVec_Core build 10.0, role checks and screened-input gates were added, and old BAMs were retired with provenance. Array 6147708 completed all nine species; Arabidopsis mapping became 96.96%. A36 temporarily excluded reads at most 120 nt, but A37 later restored the original primary threshold.

nodes.label: A28 chain rehearsal and signal correction
nodes.norm_label: a28 chain rehearsal and signal correction
nodes.summary: A28 chaining had never crossed a time boundary despite an earlier inferred success claim. A 15-minute rehearsal exposed masked wait status, launcher rather than rank signaling, compile-related SIGUSR1 suppression, missing forced-preemption continuation, first-launch failure and cleanup-kill errexit. Job 3120089 verified normal completion; 3120124 spawned child 3120146 on the forced path. SIGTERM triggered saving when SIGUSR1 remained inactive for 150 seconds; the root cause was unconfirmed.

nodes.label: A44 mixed runtime and restart caveats
nodes.norm_label: a44 mixed runtime and restart caveats
nodes.summary: A44 on September 10 records the author choosing NGC 26.08 compile on four GPUs: 12–17% savings and 6.15 hours per epoch, with mixed-runtime replication explicitly acknowledged. Fixes covered tokenizer stderr parsing and latest_state.prev recovery. Epochs leave 12 residual microbatches; confirmation seeds preserve pending gradients, frozen seed123 does not. Seed123 train_epoch_loss at epoch k is one/k of the intended mean; validation is unaffected and tables must correct it. Boundary times come from sacct Start and explicit PDT.

nodes.label: August 10 heldout and manuscript claims superseded
nodes.norm_label: august 10 heldout and manuscript claims superseded
nodes.summary: August 10 initially reported 21.6% on 2,781 supposed held-out loci versus 17.7% on exposed loci and claimed memorization was refuted. Later review found 75.8% exposure in that supposed held-out set, invalidating that interpretation. Separately, headline 18.1% from 1,103 additions across 27,413 loci (script 28) was distinguished from rerun 18.2% from 1,014 across 24,202 (script 34). Commit da5cc0f disclosed run differences and post-selected filtering.

nodes.label: August 11 critic loop corrections and replay verification
nodes.norm_label: august 11 critic loop corrections and replay verification
nodes.summary: The August 11 critic loop resolved 35 issues across ten rounds. Corrections included loci versus transcript units, alt-only AtRTD3 deletion errors, and a BUSCO lower-bound claim refuted by maize. The supposed 2,781-locus held-out set was 75.8% training-exposed and was replaced with 3,429 true test loci; anti-memorization conclusions were removed. Maize leakage involved 174 models/176 rows, and RC twins crossed splits. One fresh nine-arm replay completed in 13 h 26 m. August 17 RC coordinate repair later reproduced 92.0%.

nodes.label: August 17 independent review scientific corrections
nodes.summary: August 17 review found identity echo F1 67.8 versus completion 67.6, so whole-annotation metrics did not exceed input copying. Budget-matched AUGUSTUS exceeded TransGenic on AtRTD3 precision while TAIR10-alt superiority remained. Maize additions scored 7.9% with a richer alternative reference. Minus-strand A5SS/A3SS inversion was repaired. AtRTD3 composition was 78.0% Iso-Seq, 14.7% AtRTD2 and 7.4% Araport11; 189/204 addition matches had Iso-Seq support. All 45 showcase loci were train/validation exposed.

nodes.label: August 17 P2 completion and UTR transfer limits
nodes.norm_label: august 17 p2 completion and utr transfer limits
nodes.summary: August 17 commit d41ae76 recorded P2 completion with 262 numeric checks and 228 tests. TAIR10 CDS plus Helixer UTR scored 3.1% (221/7,092), rising to 21.6% after filtering; no-UTR was 4.6%. Corrected minus-strand donation reruns scored 1.0%/1.8% with the same three/four correct structures. Figure 3 used no-runaway anchors 92.0/74.0. Token-budget fit 99.02% differed from joint vocabulary-and-budget fit 98.89%; author-only submission details remained pending.

nodes.label: August 17 prompt transfer factorial correction
nodes.summary: August 17 found minus-strand UTR donation had worked for only 35/11,989 Helixer and 2/10,412 ANNEVO loci. Earlier 0.9%/1.2% values mixed successful plus-strand donation with failed minus-strand donation; corrected reruns became 1.0%/1.8%. Five non-donation arms retained identical hashes. Changing UTRs necessarily changes encoded extents, so minimal boundary extension left residual confounding. Reference prompting scored 18.1%, filtered reference 71.4%, and self prompting 0.1% (1/970).

nodes.label: August 4 numeric audit and rebuttal synchronization
nodes.norm_label: august 4 numeric audit and rebuttal synchronization
nodes.summary: August 4 numeric and rebuttal audits aligned AUGUSTUS scoring definitions, rescored 128 combinations with GFFCompare 0.12.6, and corrected tomato seqid-zero artifacts. Header counting inflated 29,922 to 29,923 and six table cells; tied-rank Spearman required Pearson correlation on ranks, giving CDS rho −0.88 instead of −0.81. Numeric checks were expanded to aggregates and external files. Full rebuttal reading found obsolete versions, nonexistent auxiliary segmentation training claims and edit fragments. BUSCO completeness 97.6% was measured equal for one duplicate-filter pilot, not a universal lower bound.

nodes.label: August 6 completed run loss attribution
nodes.summary: Completed August 6 runs attributed all losses: GeMoMa 29,561→29,525 involved seven EOF, four oversized, 21 parsing and four coordinate losses; BRAKER3 26,635→26,628 had seven EOF losses; EGAPx 23,515→23,467 had eighteen structural and thirty parsing losses. Unexplained losses were zero. GeMoMa’s 0.071% parsing failure rate was valid, but the sixfold comparison to TAIR was withdrawn because TAIR’s three omissions were EOF losses.

nodes.label: August 6 prompt and addition contract
nodes.summary: Gene-only prompts without CDS produce no GSF label and are skipped by prompt mode. Addition scoring excludes the supplied CDS-coordinate tuple and reports primary and alternative matching separately. The experimental primary-lock implementation injects the transcript chain after the > token using prefix_allowed_tokens_fn. ChrM preserved 31/31 prompts and produced 21 additions versus stock 27/31 and ten, but the organellar smoke did not establish alternative-splicing accuracy.

nodes.label: Duplicate prompt runners and wrong code copy
nodes.norm_label: duplicate prompt runners and wrong code copy
nodes.summary: A false-dead process interpretation from grep -F caused two tair10self runners to append to one remote DuckDB, producing 12,362 gene rows for 6,350 loci. Integrity gates caught the duplication; a lock-based orchestrator and clean rerun replaced it. Synthetic-parent GM repair initially edited an unused copy, then the actual transgenic_comparison standardizer. The locked arm stopped after 65 unexplained missing loci exceeded its gate.

nodes.label: Early Arabidopsis EST contamination interpretation
nodes.summary: The initial September 3 interpretation attributed the 73.51% aggregate mapping rate to length composition: reads over 120 bp mapped at 96.87%, and two 454 libraries comprising 791,290 records mapped at 51.45%, versus 97.15% for Sanger libraries. Three source records matched expected lengths. The stronger claim that contamination or truncation had been globally refuted was later withdrawn by A37; these measurements explain the cross-species mapping anomaly only.

nodes.label: Early prompt transfer mechanistic overclaims
nodes.summary: Early August 7 claims that UTR was the sole factor, memorization was proved, or 18% precision was impossible exceeded the experiments. Measured arm F had 12,628 additions and 275 correct (2.2%); ORF filtering retained all 275 among 4,512, and joint filtering retained 262 among 1,547 (16.9%). Later factorial, donation-bug and held-out corrections constrain those interpretations. TAIR10 CDS without versus with UTR scored 4.6% versus 18.2%.

nodes.label: Early reference citation snapshot superseded
nodes.summary: An early August 4 citation snapshot misidentified the BUSCO v6 reference as Manni 2024 and Tegenfeldt 2021. The later audit corrected it to Tegenfeldt 2025, corrected Stiehler to 2021 and updated the SegmentNT title. These are historical correction records, not a fresh external bibliographic verification.

nodes.label: EST nuccore query correction
nodes.summary: NCBI db=nucest had ceased being EST-specific and returned patent, mRNA and genome records. The corrected query used db=nuccore with species taxid and gbdiv_est[PROP]. The earlier maize 4.89-million count was all nuccore; actual EST counts were 2,019,959 for maize and 1,529,700 for Arabidopsis, with resumable eleven-species collection.

nodes.label: Exact coordinate memorization claim directly refuted
nodes.norm_label: exact coordinate memorization claim directly refuted
nodes.summary: The early coordinate-frame-only diagnosis ignored UTR differences. Controlled TAIR10 CDS prompting at 4.6% versus 18.2% with UTR contradicted UTR-irrelevance. Arm F then directly refuted the statement that only exact training coordinates could reproduce correct alternatives: Helixer boundaries still yielded 275 correct structures versus 185 with TAIR boundaries, while generating many more outputs. The archive explicitly withdraws the exact-coordinate-only claim; remaining mechanistic hypotheses are not proof of memorization.

nodes.label: External annotation polishing and software failure audit
nodes.norm_label: external annotation polishing and software failure audit
nodes.summary: External-annotation auditing found GeMoMa/EGAPx damage greatly exceeded repair, with exact protein matching falling from 77.7% to 54.2% and 83.5% to 52.1%. A wrong FAI offset, 74 rather than six, shifted sequence extraction by 68 bases. Correct indexing restored reference translation, but gffread 0.12.7 still crashed on these outputs, requiring validated direct translation. Released prompt_mode silently lost all smoke outputs at batch 32; batch one was safe. EOF gene loss, 49,152-nt silent skipping, offline relative cache paths and DB append duplication were documented.

nodes.label: FAI crash resolution claim superseded
nodes.summary: An early August 6 snapshot claimed FAI repair fixed all gffread extraction. The later consolidated audit explicitly reports persistent GeMoMa/EGAPx heap crashes even with correct indexing and without exon rows. The index repair restored reference sequence extraction; it did not establish a complete gffread crash fix.

nodes.label: Figure S4 provenance replacement
nodes.summary: Figure S4 was rebuilt from the published 27,413-locus prompted prediction instead of the unverified 4,875-locus raw file. Script 25 found 45 loci with an AtRTD3-matching chain absent from TAIR10 and at least two introns: thirteen used novel junctions, thirty-two novel combinations. GTF exon versus GFF3 CDS/UTR semantics had broken highlighting. At AT4G30510, nine was total isoforms, seven used the junction and two matched the whole chain. Earlier inference that file differences were only random test splits lacked author-confirmed provenance.

nodes.label: First CUDA launch failure correction
nodes.summary: The diagnosis that unspecified launch failure required excluding bad nodes was reversed when second launches on the same nodes repeatedly succeeded after 30 seconds. A cudaMallocAsync/nvidia_uvm initialization race under Apptainer was a diagnostic hypothesis, not an established cause. Native allocator evidence was weak. The replacement was CUDA warmup and a same-node retry before exclusion. Shell fixes covered comma-valued exports, cleanup kill status and grep-q with pipefail.

nodes.label: Historical manuscript tone correction
nodes.summary: August 4 tone editing identified repeated caveats and moved limitations to appropriate single locations without changing measurements. Later critic findings still required explicit evaluation asymmetry, returned-annotation versus additions distinctions, and bounded claims. The historical tone pass is not evidence that every scientific claim had already been validated.

nodes.label: Historical publication metadata cleanup
nodes.summary: The archive records August 20 rewriting 176 public commits to remove attribution trailers and standardize authorship, followed by September 1 PR-body cleanup. Two archived pre-rewrite PR commit messages and another owner’s fork remained outside that removal. This is a historical action record, not authorization for present history rewriting or publication.

nodes.label: Issue 60 historical exclusion superseded by A47.3
nodes.norm_label: issue 60 historical exclusion superseded by a47.3
nodes.summary: Issue 60 initially quarantined 51 PacBio runs totaling 43 GB as subreads based on filenames. September 22 A47.3 explicitly refuted this: 49 CCS transcriptome runs were restored and two WGS runs stayed excluded. Issue 63 separately added library-strategy filtering for ONT WGS SRR25241091. A September 4 check also refuted the stopped-at-Sitalica claim: the login-node driver had remained alive on that WGS download.

nodes.label: July Figure 3 source restoration and reconstruction defects
nodes.norm_label: july figure 3 source restoration and reconstruction defects
nodes.summary: July Figure 3 restoration recovered original noPost predictions and test-label pooled GFFCompare statistics, giving Arabidopsis F1 92.2 and maize 71.2. An earlier claimed length contradiction was withdrawn because reconstruction had unmapped RC rows, per-gene aggregation and a different split; original length/CDS rho were −0.109/−0.880. Reconstructor KeyError unknown affected 361 rice/maize legacy IDs and was repaired without discarding them. Test predictions required test-restricted reference, not whole-genome annotation. Later RC and runaway-output audits superseded parts of this early restoration state.

nodes.label: July figure release and submission package policy
nodes.norm_label: july figure release and submission package policy
nodes.summary: July release checks installed Liberation Sans after silent Arial fallback, used TrueType PDF embedding, corrected legends and documented all ten figures in FIGURE_HANDOFF. The author kept 073026 and its manuscript-containing artifact local/private pending submission, while code, figures and data were public. Five gitignored figure pairs required explicit addition; all ten figures returned HTTP 200. nodes.label: July reconstruction provenance and merge recovery
nodes.norm_label: july reconstruction provenance and merge recovery
nodes.summary: July’s five-panel reconstruction and claim that AT1G43770 was an original Figure 4 locus were later refuted by the author-supplied source. Separately, July 29 merged seven commits into main and verified thirty scripts publicly. During a failed merge simulation, checkout failed before reset --hard ran on the wrong branch; reflog db543fa restored all 102 files with no remote impact. Subsequent testing used isolated worktrees and verified the branch before destructive steps.

nodes.label: July submission data corrections
nodes.summary: July submission audits corrected de-novo splice-event recall from 2.9–7.7% to 0.0–0.1% (seven matches among 14,643 reference events), and maximum CDS count from 146 maize to 201 tomato. The AtRTD3 paper count 169,503 differed from the used transfix GTF’s 169,499, which was disclosed. Thirty-seven of 128 BUSCO rows had split species/tool labels incorrectly; underlying BUSCO values were unchanged.

nodes.label: October corpus transfer and cache safeguards
nodes.norm_label: october corpus transfer and cache safeguards
nodes.summary: October 1–4 corrections included 28 C0 inputs rather than 26; SQL JOIN streaming validation at 97.8 GB RSS; and obs-cache DuckDB limits accounting for roughly 80 GB of Python chromosome objects. A 170 G allocation with 60 GB DuckDB limit reached 144.9 GB. Preserve insertion order, verify output manifests before recovery, resync late sidecars, hash in jobs, and avoid dangling links: 408 links caused B5 job 3149363 preflight failure. The author forbade cpu-s3-sponsored-0 on October 2.

nodes.summary: October 12 whole-run rglob, including Inductor cache, timed out; collection switched to explicit root, trace, draw and metadata paths. Python 3.6 required gzip.GzipFile around tarfile w|. October 11 completed-job checks used the user active-job list plus sacct. October 9 tmux protocol mismatch required a dedicated socket and verified runner absence before retrying.

nodes.label: ONT scouting classification failures
nodes.summary: September 3 scouting excluded about 460 GB among 617 Arabidopsis ONT runs from 52 studies for nascent RNA, uncertain genotype, RNA-processing mutants or out-of-scope raw signals. Missing classifier flags meant unclassifiable, not clean: PRJNA815899 contained 15 knockout runs. Alias/isolate and submitted_ftp resolved missing-field assumptions. The ENA taxon-error claim was refuted as a query mix-up. AtRTD3 itself included NMD/degradation mutants and nuclear RNA, leaving an author judgment about reference consistency.

nodes.label: ORF and duplicate export definitions corrected
nodes.norm_label: orf and duplicate export definitions corrected
nodes.summary: TAIR10 primary ORF-only validity was 99.9%; ORF plus canonical introns was 95.5%, so the earlier 94%-ORF label was wrong. All 25,252 loci with two transcripts had identical structures, not distinct beam hypotheses; num_return_sequences=1 supported the DB/export duplication explanation. Organelle inclusion explained 29,713/59,426 versus 29,922/59,844. Deduplication results stayed unchanged while the causal description was corrected.

nodes.label: Polishing benchmark denominator and mechanism corrections
nodes.norm_label: polishing benchmark denominator and mechanism corrections
nodes.summary: Five scoring criteria retained at least roughly 21% GeMoMa and 26% EGAPx damage versus at most 2.42% repair. Only the first transcript is prompted; unprompted-isoform loss was at least 93.75% under junction matching and 96–100% under exact CDS. Raw loss comparisons were confounded by input isoform composition. On prompted structures BRAKER3 loss was 0.48% versus control 0.05%. BRAKER3 pure gain was only 14 structures at nine loci, unlike raw gain 128. Fifteen oversized loci were outside the 49,152-nt scope.

nodes.label: Prompt factorial measurements and generation tradeoff
nodes.norm_label: prompt factorial measurements and generation tradeoff
nodes.summary: With fixed TAIR10 CDS, the 2×2 measurements were: UTR/TAIR boundary 185 correct of 1,014 (18.2%); UTR/Helixer boundary 275 of 12,628 (2.2%); no UTR/TAIR 33 of 722 (4.6%); no UTR/Helixer 33 of 1,040 (3.2%). Altered boundaries increased correct count and recall to 5.3% while diluting precision. ANNEVO had no UTR features. The model generated UTRs on 19,735 of 23,861 preserved TAIR prompts, but only 594 were exact.

nodes.label: Prompt transfer source and filter bookkeeping
nodes.norm_label: prompt transfer source and filter bookkeeping
nodes.summary: Prompt-transfer auditing found the executed standardize_gff copy outside the repository. An ORF-zero result came from FASTA 1/Mt/Pt versus GFF Chr aliases, motivating a positive-control orf-audit. Arm F had 275 correct structures, not 278. Table S11 moved from a superseded manual document into a JSON-driven generator. All five external-tool prompt experiments measured approximately 0.0–0.1% exact-CDS precision; this did not establish universal impossibility.

nodes.label: Pytest collection collision hid A22 coverage
nodes.norm_label: pytest collection collision hid a22 coverage
nodes.summary: Duplicate test_geenuff_qc basenames prevented complete pytest collection. Two unique A22 policy/flag tests were moved to the active suite, while two guessed-schema tests were retired. Commit 73397ac enabled 409 passes and one skip, versus the previous 155-test subset. The issue-46 acceptance statement was corrected because its claimed A22 coverage had previously been unexecuted.

nodes.label: Role freeze and duplicate run checks
nodes.norm_label: role freeze and duplicate run checks
nodes.summary: EST role declarations, eleven rows with md5 a6375713, were frozen separately from ongoing long-read collection. Role checks excluded held-out maize from alignment. Cui 2020 runs SRR10611193/94/95 appeared in both training and validation paths with identical decompressed content but different gzip timestamp hashes. Dataset/run uniqueness did not catch cross-dataset run duplication, and locally recompressed checksums were not ENA source checksums.

nodes.label: September 15 failed paths and corrected provenance
nodes.norm_label: september 15 failed paths and corrected provenance
nodes.summary: September 15 DIAMOND dmnd accession filtering was unsupported despite help text; commit 950cf4c prefiltered species-specific databases using frozen lineage. Release and help-build strings needed separate checks, and getseq alone rejected no-parse-seqids. A 10,000-read sample remained NOT_FOR_TRAINING. ts:A is read-relative and needs FLAG composition. Evidence-off equals original seed123 only at shared step-zero weights. A37 min_len=100 provenance superseded older 121-nt records; failed artifacts and unresolved extern observations were preserved.

nodes.label: September 16 MVP implementation assurance boundaries
nodes.summary: September 16 MVP source was isolated cumulative commit f847cb8, not main. Pure CE is calculated per tile and off−on differences averaged equally across evidence-positive tiles. Verification covered fixed checkpoint identity, canonical LambdaLR, unused-parameter DDP, exact optimizer groups, genuine skipped-step no-ops, collective error phases, bounded gathers and atomic publication. Technical acceptance was true while scientific production approval was false; 153 CPU tests did not certify actual SIF, Hyena or GPU readiness.

nodes.label: September 1 manuscript benchmark refinements
nodes.summary: September 1 the author switched Figure 5/S1 to soft-masked Tiberius, marking failed maize and absent Vitis cells. On 25,594 shared loci and denominator 5,554, TransGenic’s 1,094 additions scored 18.3%/18.6% on the two reported reference comparisons, versus AUGUSTUS’s 43,433 at 1.3%/10.2%; budget-matched AUGUSTUS scored 0.6%/24.1%. Among 1,103 headline additions, 441 had complete ORFs, 752 canonical introns and 266 both. Release training saved every epoch because loss was compared with stored perplexity; uploaded checkpoint identity still needed author confirmation.

nodes.label: September 1 manuscript provenance corrections
nodes.summary: September 1 review documented 33 addressed, four partial and one claimed-but-absent reviewer requests; Table S10 gained actual BRAKER3, GeMoMa and EGAPx run versions. The abstract shrank from 395 to 237 words, Fisher p=0.8197 was verified, and TSS scope was limited to 400M across twelve species. Manuscript v3 had become the direct-edit canonical source, 45 paragraphs ahead of v2; script 23 would erase later work. Only supplemental figure legends still came from v2 via script 20.

nodes.label: September 1 revision and evidence design evolution
nodes.norm_label: september 1 revision and evidence design evolution
nodes.summary: September 1 planning made orthogroup retraining mandatory with the 400M encoder and separated later large-model/fine-tuning work. transcript_model was the proposed canonical source for GSF, C2, C0 and validation, with 5C/5I, 3C/3I and IC/IP/IM/IX completeness codes and molecule-witnessed chain/end combinations. Protocol v1.5 corrected earlier blanket validation-only restrictions: nine training species could use ONT, Sequel-II-plus CCS, EST and cross-species protein, while held-out species were validation-only. Independent molecules, not raw accessions or sequence clusters, govern support.

nodes.label: September 25 extern status policy
nodes.summary: On September 25 the author decided to ignore Slurm extern OUT_OF_MEMORY 0:125 markers when adjudicating jobs. Job/batch status, ExitCode, output QC and hashes determine results. Batch OOM remains material. This decision supersedes earlier unresolved extern-status gate snapshots without proving their root cause.

nodes.label: September 28 evidence corpus corrections
nodes.summary: September 25–28 author decisions allowed masked X in DIAMOND replay, excluding only unreplayable rows with QC. A19 required same-species protein filtering; A16 decision 9 counted a connected PCR component as one molecule. A22 flags must be supplied per species. Vvinifera N=100 exhaustiveness was 0.9893, motivating N=500 for all sources of that species. Changing EST C0 requires rebuilding dependent HSP/protein C0 hashes. Failed outputs remain preserved.

nodes.label: September 2 benchmark and partial pretraining audit
nodes.norm_label: september 2 benchmark and partial pretraining audit
nodes.summary: September 2 RTX 4090 measurements gave 30-kb 12.05 GB/0.70 s and 61-kb 16.94 GB/1.54 s; 129 kb OOM occurred in 1,093 of 1,103 batches. The early 27-GB extrapolation was not a production guarantee. A35 forbade silent failed-batch skipping. A 50-step benchmark never reached save step 200; its success could not certify saving. The protein brute-force oracle shared the same leak. A43 retired acceptance v1. nodes.label: Five review rounds prevent aggregate metric misinterpretation
nodes.norm_label: five review rounds prevent aggregate metric misinterpretation
nodes.rationale: Aggregates combine distinct mechanisms and unequal denominators; prompt survival, pure addition, replacement and reference tautologies must be separated.
nodes.summary: Five review rounds corrected nineteen aggregate-metric errors. Three TAIR omissions were EOF losses, not parsing failures; 99.95% survival applied to prompted representatives, not all structures. Pure-addition exact-CDS precision was about 0.65%, while chain matching was 31.4%/33.0%; most matched chains merely reused the prompt with altered ends, leaving nineteen new chains per external tool. For reference-as-input controls, added∩reference=empty and dropped⊆reference are identities, not performance findings. Decomposition exposed errors both favorable and unfavorable to the model.

nodes.label: GPU memory peak interpretation reversal
nodes.rationale: The sampling interval was far longer than the memory peak duration, so driver samples could not disprove process peak accounting.
nodes.summary: The September 9 claim that torch max_memory_allocated near 101 GB was only allocator bookkeeping was explicitly reversed that evening. Two-second nvidia-smi samples ranged from 14.8 to 97.3 GB because they missed brief peaks; torch 101 GB was consistent with the observed 100.65-GB no-checkpoint OOM. The three-step 11-GB probe did not reproduce in the longer run. Driver sampled maxima are lower bounds, and three-step probes are unsuitable for sizing.

nodes.label: October 6 allocator only remedy rejected
nodes.rationale: Allocator tuning cannot remove live allocations; diagnose the measured memory source before changing behavior or repeating expensive experiments.
nodes.summary: October 6 rejected expandable_segments alone as a pilot GPU-OOM fix. Smoke 3321974 was submitted then canceled after review: only about 6 GiB of fragmentation could be recovered while 87 GiB allocated memory remained. The prescribed next step was a measured one-GPU diagnosis before further four-GPU smoke tests. Padding or bucketing could not promise bit identity and required an author decision.

nodes.label: October ObsCache mmap recovery
nodes.rationale: Shared mmap pages replace replication of heavy per-process Python objects; a small shard LRU alone trades memory pressure for repeated I/O.
nodes.summary: October 4–6 real-data pilot link1 host OOM reached 465 GB in both arms despite synthetic CP4 and memory-benchmark passes. Per-process NumPy object caching cost about 975 B per row across 20 processes. Shared mmap Arrow, dictionary encoding and decoding only returned rows replaced it. LRU 8 alone starved GPUs; serial prebuild and B6_OBS_CACHE_REQUIRE_PREBUILT=1 prevented concurrent writers.

nodes.summary: B6 de novo, with zero tracks and masked chain memory, is the headline; evidence mode accompanies every main-text comparison. B5 seed 123 is the supplemental legacy comparator and returns as headline only if G1 fails: lower 95% paired-locus CI for B6 de novo−C2 transcript F1 <−1 pp. G2 failure alone withholds the evidence claim. Maize input is M-EST+M-HQ18, scoring M-FLNC+root-tip ONT. The 121-nt EST arm never supplies input. MVP has no C2/fallback role; route-B phase is included, route A cross-checks it and C6 ablates it.

nodes.label: A46 validation input versus independent scoring allocation
nodes.norm_label: a46 validation input versus independent scoring allocation
nodes.summary: Roles b6_input/b6_score are declared and hashed before inference. Training molecules are train_track, excluded_heldout or never; only eligible excluded A-EST/A-ONT2 can enter Arabidopsis held-out inference. Score with A-ONT1 plus six WT A-CCS23 runs; A-HiFi is missing, A-CCS23 TES is missing. Panel-restricted alignment uses windows±10 kb prefilter then full reference for final 1,729 and pilot 300 loci; the B1 full-run ONT pass is not executed. Junction thresholds pool within source, ONT ≥3 or PacBio ≥2, never across sources; retain per-run results. Reference F1 is reference-dependent.

nodes.label: A46 zero-evidence model, nested thinning and runtime gates
nodes.norm_label: a46 zero-evidence model, nested thinning and runtime gates
nodes.summary: B6 adds a no-bias track projection before encoder downsampling and gated chain blocks; reference GSF loss remains the sole loss. Zero tracks/masked chains must match sequence-only eager fp32 behavior; generation parity is tested. Tile dropout is 0.5; retained fractions {0.01,0.1,0.5,1}, source/library withholding each 0.1, aug_seed=20260914+seed. Eight-byte big-endian blake2b ranks of UTF-8 seed/species/molecule keys create nested subsets shared by tracks/chains. Select one best de novo validation checkpoint, patience 3, ceiling 22, effective batch 96. Resume binds full runtime/spec hashes; Dynamo fallback fails and >110 GB reserved per rank aborts.

nodes.label: A46 molecule-wide exclusion audit and repaired DNA masks
nodes.norm_label: a46 molecule-wide exclusion audit and repaired dna masks
nodes.summary: A46 drops a molecule from all training tracks if any member placement on either strand overlaps held-out/test/valid-as-applicable, hard, overlap, decoy or edge-partial intervals. An exclusion-only audit replaces --secondary=no with --secondary=yes -N 50 -p 0.5; it never supplies labels. Capped or low-MAPQ unauditable molecules are excluded; shared excluded junction coordinates are removed and retained held-out count must be zero. B6 repairs exposed edge-crossing DNA masks. B6 and its repaired sequence comparator share one identical-row DuckDB corpus; old B5 exposure is reported. A49.2 refines exhaustiveness floors.

nodes.label: A46 exploratory MVP STOP, GO and missing-evidence safeguard
nodes.norm_label: a46 exploratory mvp stop, go and missing-evidence safeguard
nodes.summary: MVP uses 50 excluded-from-final loci, A-EST input, A-ONT1+A-CCS23 scoring, B5 seed-123 best epoch 4, three seeds and fractions 0/1; no full C0/audit/chain memory. Primary Δloss=off−on with one-sided paired-tile 95% bootstrap. Evaluate STOP first if upper<0.005 nats, no positive F1/structural contradiction and no withholding reversal. Otherwise GO requires lower>0 and all seed estimates positive; else INCONCLUSIVE. Missing structural alignment by day 5 or unassessable withholding downgrades prospective STOP to INCONCLUSIVE, never GO. No promotion/fallback authority; historical budget ≈18 GPU-hours plus ≈5.5 on STOP path.

nodes.label: A46 disjoint panels, selection funnel and power reporting
nodes.norm_label: a46 disjoint panels, selection funnel and power reporting
nodes.summary: Seed 20260914 shuffles 2,079 eligible Arabidopsis loci from 3,430 holdouts after excluding 28 organellar, 4 A22 flags, 67 A30 cautions, 910 single-exon, 5 boundary and 337 overlapping genes. MVP selects the first 50 satisfying ≤20 kb and ≥3 distinct primary EST placements; pilot uses first 300 remaining, final all 1,729 others. All panels are disjoint; 350-locus attrition and gene-level exclusions limit representativeness. Panel SHA256 is 79367154bbf922fd0554285cb6cb47ae3d3c866b145aa1f51ead4f47b00cd243. Power is descriptive from pilot variance, not an approval/go gate; final panel is used once.

nodes.label: A46 C0 observation schema and evidence role carve-outs
nodes.norm_label: a46 c0 observation schema and evidence role carve-outs
nodes.summary: B6 training input uses nine-species ≥100-nt screened EST, ONT, Sequel II+ PacBio and filtered proteins, never test species or Arabidopsis validation-only sets. Held-out inference permits designated b6_input rows: Arabidopsis excluded A-EST/A-ONT2 and maize M-EST/M-HQ18, the latter tracks only. Full C0 molecule/block/junction/partial-chain schema adds est_protein_hsp with source, frame, scores, phase and tool/hash provenance. Molecule units include EST versions/mates/split parts. Protein counts use organisms but leakage closure uses whole query sequences. A46 permits separately reported cross-species Swiss-Prot phase input.

nodes.label: A46 G1–G3 gates and nested evidence dose response
nodes.norm_label: a46 g1–g3 gates and nested evidence dose response
nodes.summary: Use GFFCompare 0.12.6 transcript F1, exact intron-chain match (monoexonic exact CDS), identical all-reference/all-prediction denominators and 2,000 paired-locus bootstrap replicates, seed 20260914, percentile 95% CI. G1: lower(B6 de novo−C2) ≥−1 pp. G2: both lower(evidence−de novo) and lower(evidence−C5)>0; empty C5 output counts zero recall. G3: grammar violations/1,000 ≤B5 and recall ≥0.9×B5. Abort leakage, replay/RC/resume failure, fallback or memory abort. Dose response uses fractions 1/0.5/0.1/0.01/0, five nested draws, archived molecule manifests and rerasterization.

nodes.label: A46 frozen 31-channel evidence raster and phase projection
nodes.norm_label: a46 frozen 31-channel evidence raster and phase projection
nodes.summary: A46 freezes float16 K=31 channels: EST/ONT/PacBio each [cov+, cov−, cov?, donor+, acceptor+, donor−, acceptor−, availability], protein CDS coverage, and six phase-by-strand channels. Use log1p molecule coverage clipped at log1p(64), without reference features or tile normalization; genotype/QC flags are not channels. DIAMOND blastx ≥2.1.24 uses --frameshift 15 --evalue 1e-5 --min-orf 30 --max-target-seqs 25; ≥30-aa HSP frames project through spliced ESTs. Route-A/B disagreement zeros phase evidence. RC swaps strand channels but preserves donor/acceptor roles and phase labels; source permutation is [1,0,2,5,6,3,4,7].

nodes.label: A29 block splits and orthogroup sequence masking
nodes.norm_label: a29 block splits and orthogroup sequence masking
nodes.rationale: Avoid training-set collapse while preventing model seeing held-out DNA or learning false no-gene labels.
nodes.summary: A29 replaces restrictive member-gene tile splits with seeded 75/10/15 genomic blocks of 1,032,192 nt. Tile split is the most restrictive overlapping block. Genes with more restrictive orthogroup membership are removed from labels and N-masked; less restrictive genes may remain, so test tiles report all genes and test-orthogroup genes separately. The initial held-out-locus block forcing and fixed 100-nt mask flank are superseded by A31 and A33. Gene orthogroup assignments remain authoritative.

nodes.label: A18/A20 C2 weights, evidence classes and genotype acceptance
nodes.norm_label: a18/a20 c2 weights, evidence classes and genotype acceptance
nodes.rationale: EST boundary precision motivates stronger splice weights, while uncertain transcript ends retain lower EST exon/end weights.
nodes.summary: A18/A20 use W = min(4, 1 + source_weight × genotype × log1p(independent units)). Genotype multiplier is 1 for reference and 0.5 otherwise. Junction/intron weights are EST 1.0, PacBio 0.9, ONT 0.7, protein 0.5 with ≥2 agreeing organisms; exon/UTR weights are 0.6/1.0/0.8, protein 1.0 for CDS only. Unsupported distinctions are neutral; retained-intron-like low-support blocks get exon weight 0.25. Weighted CE is normalized per window; unit-weight ablation mandatory. Acceptance requires MAPQ ≥20, query fraction ≥0.8, identity ≥95% EST/ONT or ≥98% CCS/FLNC, anchored canonical junctions and unique locus.

nodes.label: Callable denominators and multidimensional evidence
nodes.summary: chain_callable requires a same-strand read spanning the outer junctions plus 20 nt, irrespective of structure; junction_callable requires spanning evidence for every novel junction. locus_covered records any same-strand overlap. Report rates over all additions and the appropriate callable subset. Uncovered or noncallable additions are never negative evidence. Source-specific and union tables retain chain support, novel-junction support, callability, source and annotation independence rather than replacing these with a summary tier.

nodes.label: A42 win_v3 recipe and exact-tier benchmark
nodes.norm_label: a42 win_v3 recipe and exact-tier benchmark
nodes.summary: A42 names configs/b5_400m_win_v3.json as authoritative for every B5 seed and benchmark; ctx_v2 is historical single-target configuration. Six benchmarks pin each tier on one and four GPUs. DeltaAI corrections address USR1 wait handling, default per-GPU memory billing, reliable GPU-count variables, Slurm directive expansion, work/apptainer paths and CPU-only jobs being Delta-only. These recorded costs and environment assumptions belong to the September launch history, not current allocation settings.

nodes.label: Complete-chain support differs from full-length transcript support
nodes.norm_label: complete-chain support differs from full-length transcript support
nodes.summary: Complete-chain support requires one same-strand alignment matching the full ordered corrected intron list, with no extra internal intron and ≥20 nt beyond the outer junctions. Terminal exons, UTRs and CDS start/stop are outside this criterion, so it is never called full-length transcript support. Combination-novel additions require a single read carrying the entire chain; constituent junctions on different reads do not establish the combination. Truncated reads support only the junctions they actually span.

nodes.label: A28 job-chain checkpoint state and historical resubmission
nodes.norm_label: a28 job-chain checkpoint state and historical resubmission
nodes.summary: A28 originally chains 48-hour Slurm jobs with newest completed-epoch/latest_state resume. Checkpoints include model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, epoch/step/global-step and early-stopping state, atomically published; default saves every 200 optimizer steps and before time limits. Runtime recipe changes inside a chain are forbidden. Microbatch skipping preserves sample order; sync markers prevent repeated copying. Original self-resubmission and maximum eight links are historical; A44 repairs checkpoint/signal behavior and A45 adopts three links queued in advance.

nodes.label: A16 read terminal/internal completeness and S12d QC
nodes.norm_label: a16 read terminal/internal completeness and s12d qc
nodes.summary: A16 separates 5C/5I, 3C/3I and IC/IP/IM/IX. FLNC library labels do not establish 5C; direct RNA defaults 5I absent cap/CAGE. Terminal-incomplete reads can support full intron chains with 20-nt anchors but not TSS/TES/UTR boundary/start/GSF. ONT PCR units use library, strand, corrected chain and endpoints within 10 nt; PacBio uses source ZMW/FLNC, direct RNA individual reads. S12d reports completeness and mapping/QC by species × protocol × library, never pooled protocol completeness.

nodes.label: Separately frozen EST and long-read dataset roles
nodes.norm_label: separately frozen est and long-read dataset roles
nodes.summary: EST and long-read scopes were frozen separately because collection finished at different times. EST manifest MD5 is a6375713ca2321c6a0cc55acc8e1d7fe. The September 4 long-read refreeze is c2f4c2e8fe68b3e522abb8298e1999ff with 215 rows: 129 training eligible, 31 validation only, 55 excluded. Seven missing Arabidopsis runs exposed false fetch completion and were recovered against ENA checksums/read counts. Roles must be complete, unambiguous and deduplicated. A38 declares deliberately absent SRR25203456. These counts are historical: A47.3 later changes 49 roles.

nodes.label: A38 declared absent excluded run and auditable refreeze
nodes.norm_label: a38 declared absent excluded run and auditable refreeze
nodes.rationale: A filesystem scan cannot distinguish never considered from considered and rejected; scope must be machine-auditable.
nodes.summary: A38 declares excluded, never-collected rice SRR25203456 in DECLARED_RUNS rather than inventing DONE/FASTA files. ENA metadata records 13,195,758 reads; a measured directory-valued download path motivated exclusion. The manifest must contain exactly one row and fail if a later scan duplicates the declaration. The September 4 refreeze adds one excluded row: 214→215, excluded 54→55, MD5 d644278f6a18a8b2b2162c8378cf61a8→c2f4c2e8fe68b3e522abb8298e1999ff. Eligibility and evidence content otherwise do not change.

nodes.label: A18 effective counting and support precedence
nodes.norm_label: a18 effective counting and support precedence
nodes.summary: A18 gives operational precedence over older text: ONT non-UMI PCR-equivalence units share library, strand, corrected chain and endpoints within 10 nt; direct RNA uses reads. ONT needs ≥3 units, high confidence ≥2 runs or ≥5 units. PacBio uses source FLNC/ZMW molecules, never polished clusters; ≥2 units, high confidence ≥2 runs or ≥3 units. EST units merge accession versions/clones or identical same-library alignment signatures, capped at 10/library; ≥2 units. Internal priming rejects downstream 20 nt with ≥12 As or a run ≥6 As. Cui is training eligible, excluded from Arabidopsis replication.

nodes.label: A8/A11 EST ingestion, ambiguity and no clustering
nodes.norm_label: a8/a11 est ingestion, ambiguity and no clustering
nodes.summary: A8 forbids clustering and counts aligned portions only. It specifies adapter/poly(A) trimming, ≥100 nt post-trim length, ≤5% N, low-complexity and organelle/rRNA screening, chimera rejection, strand-ambiguous coverage-only use and locus-ambiguous family-only use. The long historical command line and vector rejection wording are not all operative: A18 supplies mapper precedence and A21 supplies split-at-vector policy; A37 restores the primary 100-nt floor. A11 excludes sequence-cluster representatives, cluster sizes and imputed features from evidence.

nodes.label: A36 superseded by A37: 100 nt primary, 121 nt sensitivity
nodes.norm_label: a36 superseded by a37: 100 nt primary, 121 nt sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Outcome-driven ascertainment changed support/callability across species without an inapplicable rule; frozen text alone did not preserve frozen quantities.
nodes.summary: A36 raised the EST floor to 121 nt after observing mapping rates; A37 explicitly retracts this post hoc ascertainment change and restores ≥100 nt as primary. ≥121 nt is a labelled sensitivity arm, paired for every EST-derived quantity, including length-bin callability, junction support, chain complexity and gene length. Raw pre-screening BAMs are not evidence. Arabidopsis's anomaly is explained by length composition, not proof against contamination; platform/library/tissue/year/complexity remain confounded. Default min length is 100, explicit 121 uses separate alignment outputs.

nodes.label: A1–A2 EST source correction and partial-chain graph
nodes.norm_label: a1–a2 est source correction and partial-chain graph
nodes.summary: A1 corrects retired dbEST retrieval to nuccore with organism taxid AND gbdiv_est, 10,000-record batches, eleven species and explicit suppressed-record differences. Maize/Arabidopsis metadata retain clone, cultivar, tissue, stage and library. A2 builds ordered partial chains and links consistent same-clone/library pairs within 200 kb. A junction/adjacency splice graph defines candidate space only, never molecule support; adjacency fraction is secondary. A11 later forbids imputing adjacency through an unsequenced clone-pair gap.

nodes.label: A21 UniVec_Core EST vector screening
nodes.summary: A21 requires UniVec_Core screening before EST alignment with fixed VecScreen blastn parameters and database/tool provenance. Terminal strong/moderate hits trim the end; internal strong hits split at the match, retaining pieces ≥100 nt as one molecule unit. Internal moderate and weak hits are flagged only; short products drop. Strong terminal/internal score thresholds are 24/30, moderate 19/25, weak 16/23; terminal means within 25 nt. Only screened FASTA is aligned, with per-record actions and kept/trimmed/split/dropped QC.

nodes.label: A23 evidence-primary isoform and secondary S4
nodes.norm_label: a23 evidence-primary isoform and secondary s4
nodes.summary: A23 ranks isoforms by complete-chain molecule units, minimum intron support, CDS length, then canonical order. Monoexonic support uses reads contained in the exon. If every transcript has zero full-chain support, the locus is uncalled rather than defaulting to annotation primary. S4 reports called fraction and agreement with annotation/first canonical prediction, stratified by source, EST 3′ bias and cultivar. Partial chains affect bottleneck only. This is evaluation/QC/B3 evidence, not a training target under this amendment.

nodes.label: A50.2 evlabel segmentation remains separate from B6
nodes.norm_label: a50.2 evlabel segmentation remains separate from b6
nodes.summary: A50.2 makes evidence-derived UTR/exon/intron/splice labels a separate gated evlabel segmentation deliverable, distinct from A46's C2 comparator. They change no B6 target, gradient, checkpoint selection, arm or gate: B6 uses reference GSF loss only, with evidence entering tracks/chain memory as input. Preserve neutral unsupported cells, capped weights and unit-weight ablation. A segmentation consumer must not update registered B6 through a shared encoder; loss, splits, independent endpoints and success criteria require a further amendment before training.

nodes.label: A35 no skipped batches under a frozen recipe
nodes.norm_label: a35 no skipped batches under a frozen recipe
nodes.rationale: Silent skipped batches delete training data and invalidate preregistered study despite plausible losses/checkpoints.
nodes.summary: A35 follows a 24-GB benchmark where 1,093/1,103 largest-tier batches OOMed and were silently skipped. Frozen --config training permits zero skipped batches: OOM raises with sample/shapes/memory diagnostics, and every non-OOM exception propagates. Legacy no-config OOM behavior is retained. Accumulation and epoch loss count completed microbatches rather than loader indices. The protocol requires hardware fitting the 129,024-nt tier; silent data deletion cannot be mistaken for successful training.

nodes.label: Frozen reference and prediction identities
nodes.summary: Frozen input identities include the maize AGPv4 genome (MD5 a8d3069cd9554885670848cc3df185cb), maize completion predictions (08b45a51e9116f2901b447b9787c7544), TAIR10 genome (987ca803466e79f98b7f06af8ca94557) and Arabidopsis beam1 predictions (670d419b887271e0a9b8a4d82b9bf700). Scoring definitions are fixed at commit 21e8752, tag revision-2026-09; new scoring code may add outputs without changing definitions. A40 later adopts the 273,148-row B5 replacement corpus and corrected tokenizer.

nodes.label: A32 hard-flagged gene masking preserves neighboring tiles
nodes.norm_label: a32 hard-flagged gene masking preserves neighboring tiles
nodes.rationale: Remove wrong structures while retaining correct neighboring genes.
nodes.summary: A32 changes tile masking after 690 flagged Arabidopsis genes removed 13.8/26.4/45.5% of tiles across tiers. Hard genes are N-masked with flank and removed from labels, while tile train_weight stays 1; hard_masked counts are reported. Individual flagged transcripts still drop independently, and gene-centered hard-gene rows retain weight 0. Only labelled genes remain in window_genes. This preserves correct neighboring genes without changing evaluation references.

nodes.label: A24 constrained B5 primary inference and unconstrained control
nodes.norm_label: a24 constrained b5 primary inference and unconstrained control
nodes.summary: A24 preregisters constrained decoding as primary B5 inference and unconstrained decoding as parity control for every B5-era benchmark. Deterministic beams forbid malformed coordinates/order/strand/phase, undefined or repeated transcript members, missing CDS and transcript-plan mismatch. Frame consistency remains with structural filter F because token-level enforcement risks deadlocks. Report unconstrained violation classes alongside both arms. Existing published-checkpoint predictions are not redecoded; a C2 HMM/CRF decoder remains follow-up.

nodes.label: A31 held-out loci protected without forcing test blocks
nodes.norm_label: a31 held-out loci protected without forcing test blocks
nodes.summary: A31 removes forced test-block assignment after 3,430 distributed Arabidopsis holdouts made 120/121 blocks test and left only 23 training tiles. Blocks use the seeded 75/10/15 draw; held-out genes remain test orthogroups and are N-masked/unlabelled in train/valid tiles. Neighboring genes and intergenic sequence may be seen. Evaluation uses real sequence. The document distinguishes 3,430 corpus holdouts from earlier 3,429-locus evaluation references; these are retained as reported, not silently reconciled.

nodes.label: Model and reference independence of transcript evidence
nodes.norm_label: model and reference independence of transcript evidence
nodes.summary: Model independence and reference independence are separate reported dimensions. ONT and PacBio are equal tier 1; EST and full-length cDNA are tier 2 and historically contributed to references. Initial maize sources are PRJNA822071 ONT, PRJEB32007 Wang 2020 FLNC and PRJEB22122 Wang 2018 HQ; Arabidopsis includes FLIC PRJNA1087576, Cui PRJNA594286 and Zhong PRJEB77203. Exclude Wang 2016 V4 evidence and AtRTD3's own Iso-Seq. Later role/product amendments supersede parts of this initial table.

nodes.label: A11 independent EST molecule and library counting
nodes.norm_label: a11 independent est molecule and library counting
nodes.rationale: Raw accession counts inflate support through resequencing and clone-pair duplicates.
nodes.summary: A11 merges accession versions and normalized physical clone identities into one molecule. Clone pairs support only actually aligned blocks/junctions, never a gap-imputed chain. Without clone IDs, collapse only same-library identical assembly/contig/strand/CIGAR-block signatures. Independent preparations define libraries; runs/plates/batches do not. Cap each library at 10 units/junction; replicated support needs ≥2 libraries and high-confidence EST junctions ≥2 units. Each accepted EST supports one unique locus, without fractional counting. Retain accession/molecule/library/project/signature identities. Compute estimates are historical.

nodes.label: Source-specific junction support and coordinate correction
nodes.norm_label: source-specific junction support and coordinate correction
nodes.summary: Both corrected intron boundaries must match on the same strand. ONT: ≥20 nt anchors, ≤2 mismatches, no indels within 6 nt, unique canonical correction ≤±3 nt; PacBio uses ≤±1 nt correction. EST: ≥15 nt anchors, ≤1 mismatch, no indels within 8 nt, no correction. Raw and corrected coordinates are retained; ambiguous corrections rejected. Historical read/clone thresholds become independent molecule-unit thresholds under A11/A16/A18. Noncanonical predictions are flagged and fail F by construction.

nodes.label: A12–A15 long-read role and platform changes
nodes.norm_label: a12–a15 long-read role and platform changes
nodes.summary: A12 restricted PacBio to Sequel II+; A13 made downloaded long reads validation-only; A14 supersedes both by allowing training-species ONT/Sequel II+ with leakage exclusions and any reference-independent PacBio generation for withheld maize/tomato validation. Cui is Arabidopsis training eligible, FLIC/Zhong validation only. A15 adds maize M-CCS26, hybrid M-KNX and Arabidopsis WT A-CCS23 SRR22719002–07. Later A47–A47.3 refine actual deposited products and restore A-CCS23 structural scoring except TES. Product identity is not established by an ENA-generated filename.

nodes.label: A33 overlap closure, randomized masks and edge guarantees
nodes.norm_label: a33 overlap closure, randomized masks and edge guarantees
nodes.summary: A33 masks whole overlap-connected components for leak/hard/decoy seeds, with seeded uniform 50–150 nt flank. Drop train/valid tiles above 0.60 masked fraction. Train-only decoy probability min(0.05, m/3) reduces N-run artifacts; it is not leakage protection and never applies to validation. Training requires complete containment; inference has 1,000-nt margins except contig edges. Three offsets guarantee lengths ≤18,480/38,960/84,016 nt by tier; 86/334,642 genes exceed the largest guarantee and are reported. Report cap rejection, mask counts, duplicates and masked-fraction distributions.

nodes.label: A44 historical mixed-runtime confirmation seeds
nodes.summary: A44 initially assigns confirmation seeds to NGC 26.08, whole-model compile, four GH200 ranks, accumulation 24 and non-reentrant checkpointing, while seed 123 remains NGC 25.06 eager on one GPU. It explicitly disclaims runtime neutrality. Signal/exit-code handling, atomic latest_state publication and pending-gradient epoch resume are corrected; old seed-123 train-loss reporting is corrected in results, not logs. Twenty-two epochs is a ceiling, not a fixed schedule. A45 supersedes the mixed-runtime plan by restarting seed 123.

nodes.label: A17/A18 separate ORF completeness and chain evidence
nodes.norm_label: a17/a18 separate orf completeness and chain evidence
nodes.summary: A17 assigns ORFs only after alignment, using genome-spliced sequence in three transcript-oriented frames, not error-prone read sequence. DIAMOND cds_candidate triage is QC-only. ORF-incomplete, noncoding or terminal-incomplete chains may supply chain/junction evidence but cannot produce the CDS-required GSF labels. A18 limits training-source restrictions to training uses; designated validation sets still score B1/B4. It also corrects 'Track C1': C1 is the B5 canonical-order control, while evidence-derived chain objectives remain inactive follow-up at that amendment stage.

nodes.label: A19 OrthoDB v12 filtered protein label resource
nodes.norm_label: a19 orthodb v12 filtered protein label resource
nodes.summary: A19 selects OrthoDB v12 Viridiplantae as the primary protein label resource. Exclude evaluated taxa Arabidopsis 3702, maize 4577 and tomato 4081, plus training test-orthogroup proteins; uncertain reference-derived unmapped training sequences are excluded. Frozen resource: 12,115,085 sequences, 408 taxa, MD5 453cb32b02e0799950d7d5f62ac. Miniprot acceptance requires identity ≥30%, coverage ≥70%, no frameshift, canonical GT–AG/GC–AG introns ≤200 kb; equal-best loci are family-level only. Support units are organisms; labels are CDS-family, with junction labels only for ≥2 agreeing organisms. Never B1 support or UTR/GSF labels.

nodes.label: A33 overlapping blocks and locus-aware stitching
nodes.norm_label: a33 overlapping blocks and locus-aware stitching
nodes.summary: A33 permits overlapping/nested gene blocks, ordered by (gene_start, gene_end, canonical_block). Generation enforces starts only; post-decoding canonicalization repairs tie order, logged as notice. Same-strand identical-CDS annotation duplicates collapse to longest span then canonical tie-break. Stitch identical signatures first; other predictions are the same locus only if same strand, not separately co-emitted, reciprocal CDS overlap ≥0.90 and shared intron for multi-exon pairs or both endpoints within 1,000 nt for monoexons. Resolve by edge distance, larger tier, fewer violations, canonical order.

nodes.label: A34 partial HyenaDNA initialization audit
nodes.rationale: Changing initialization would alter published recipe parity; stacked layers/fully random/function-preserving widening reserved follow-up ablations.
nodes.summary: A34 records the 768-wide, 12-layer encoder's partial transfer from a 256-wide, 8-layer HyenaDNA checkpoint: 339 target tensors, 80 exact, 147 tiled/cropped and 112 random, including layers 8–11. Initialization is deliberately unchanged; prefix cropping preserves absolute position. Frozen expected counts and missing-key rules fail closed, with a deliberate documented drift override. Archive per-tensor audit. Methods must say partially pretrained; observed performance does not isolate conventional full-checkpoint transfer from supervised training and tile/crop initialization.

nodes.label: B1 P1–P5 outcomes and success gates
nodes.norm_label: b1 p1–p5 outcomes and success gates
nodes.summary: P1 measures complete-chain support with Wilson 95% CIs; P2 compares exact-CDS precision to maize baseline 266/3,363 = 7.9%; P3 measures novel-junction support; P4 uses ≥500 reference alternatives, seed 123; P5 shifts each decoy intron +9 nt with canonical status flagged. Out-of-sample filter validation requires callable chain support ≥2× unfiltered and exact-CDS precision ≥3× (23.7%), each CI excluding the unfiltered point. Abstract promotion also requires ≥30% callable filtered chain support and P4 ≥50%. Controls precede blinded addition scoring; otherwise report species-specific/post hoc limitations.

nodes.label: A41 pronghorn protein query partition and verified merge
nodes.norm_label: a41 pronghorn protein query partition and verified merge
nodes.rationale: Query count—not measured by fixed-query sizing pilot—caused memory jumps; partition neutrality was measured before adoption.
nodes.summary: A41 moves protein alignment to pronghorn CPU and splits 12,115,085 queries into six ordered chunks after full-query OOMs. First five contain 2,019,181 sequences, last 2,019,180; verify counts and concatenated uncompressed-source MD5. Pilot job 6152995 compared original/repeated 100k and two 50k arms: identical GFF and acceptance results after local-ID normalization. Merge renumbers only column-9 ID/Parent, never MP-like query names, and checks all chunks/reference/parameters/counts. Only merged species output is a result. Fixed-query sizing had not measured query-count memory dependence.

nodes.label: A43 excludes ambiguous proteins before support aggregation
nodes.norm_label: a43 excludes ambiguous proteins before support aggregation
nodes.summary: A43 finds v1 protein support tables aggregated locus-specific CDS/intron evidence before equal-best multi-locus ambiguity was known. support_version 2, commit 5bc4df8, retains protein IDs and excludes mapping_ambiguous contributions before aggregation. Rerun array 6156132 uses unchanged merged GFFs; acceptance fractions stay unchanged. V1 outputs are preserved but forbidden for labels/weights. Removing ambiguous contributions reduces coverage intervals 2–7% and ≥2-organism introns 1.3–4.1%; A18 counts and A19 boundary labels use v2 only.

nodes.label: A39 -uf gate measures read orientation, not splice motif
nodes.norm_label: a39 -uf gate measures read orientation, not splice motif
nodes.rationale: Original estimator algebra is invariant to library orientation; repair measures the assertion -uf actually makes.
nodes.summary: A39 fixes the -uf audit from motif/annotation agreement, which is invariant to library orientation, to read genomic strand versus annotation among eligible motif-consistent alignments. Preserve the 10,000-read pilot and ≥95% threshold; unresolved never enables -uf. All 27 Arabidopsis runs previously passed, but read-orientation fractions separate antisense 0.128–0.186, unstranded 0.492–0.527 and sense 0.991–0.994, leaving four passes. motif_annotation_agreement remains QC. Retained pilot SAMs are rescored and completion markers bind scorer identity; no long-read alignment had yet run.

nodes.label: A45 same-runtime seed restart and prequeued chain
nodes.norm_label: a45 same-runtime seed restart and prequeued chain

nodes.label: Generative DNA-to-isoform origin
nodes.summary: Early research notebook proposes pretrained DNA encoder embeddings plus relatively small pretrained decoder to generate all isoforms, initially coordinate lists, with long-gene segmentation and embedding conversion open questions.

nodes.label: Isoform-specific metric questions
nodes.summary: Proposed analysis distinguishes genes with/without alternative splicing, correct transcript count, per-transcript CDS/UTR feature recovery, per-gene perfect transcripts and total perfect transcripts.

nodes.label: Iterative prompting and start-stop tracks
nodes.summary: Notebook proposes SegmentNT-guided coordinate correction and prompting modes for de novo, primary-transcript completion and feature-to-isoform generation. Repurposed start/stop tracks overfit; freezing mapping layers for5epochs helped. Shuffled feature/transcript labels after2epochs did not outperform original; TRL/BLEU reinforcement-learning attempt abandoned due to custom-model complexity.

nodes.label: LED and custom structured-output vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Long contexts motivated LED, while custom tokens and a new head reduced redundant textual GFF representation.
nodes.summary: Historical transition from T5 to LED sought long-context memory efficiency; full LED required encoder→encoder→decoder for PEFT compatibility. Custom vocabulary, decoder embedding and LM head reduced GFF redundancy; EOS improved structure, while ten-epoch AthChr4 trial still produced wrong coordinates.

nodes.label: SegmentNT U-Net joint model proposal
nodes.rationale: Strong base-level coverage but weak exact junction/isoform accuracy motivated nucleotide-resolution probabilities.
nodes.summary: Stage2 proposed U-Net base probabilities alongside generative decoder to refine junction coordinates and scan for genic regions. Initial U-Net eval loss plateaued≈0.42 despite learning-rate/weight/batch/clipping changes. Poor small-window performance after12288nt training motivated fixed6144 windows and attention masking.

nodes.label: Whole-sequence encoding and on-the-fly embeddings
nodes.rationale: Whole genes preserve distant splice signals and avoid requiring an existing primary annotation; precomputed embeddings were too large.
nodes.summary: Notebook rejects exon/intron truncation as primary path because complete genes avoid isoform-size complications and reliance on primary annotation. Precomputed AthChr4 embeddings for4127genes consumed33GB, motivating on-the-fly encoding. Distant intronic and exonic splicing signals motivate retaining full context.

nodes.label: Source-specific support denominators

nodes.label: Genome-spliced ORF and GSF eligibility
nodes.summary: Assign ORFs from genome spliced through the observed exon chain,not error-prone reads. Search three oriented frames; complete ATG–stop/no internal stop/mod3,denovo>=100aa,homology>=30aa/E<=1e-10/identity>=30%/coverage>=70%. Rank permitted reference CDS,then cross-species homology,then longest valid ORF. Incomplete ends generally GSF-ineligible;MP/MX no ORF. NMD-like stop>=50nt before last junction remains structure evidence but coding GSF needs support;uORFs not main by position. Phases=(3−cumulative mod3) mod3;GSF needs complete witnessed model,CDS/support/caps/roundtrip/no leakage.

nodes.label: Observed-witness collapse invariant
nodes.rationale: Prevent unsupported assembled transcript structures and invented combinations of endpoints from entering evidence-derived models.
nodes.summary: Every emitted chain and joint5prime/3prime endpoints must be witnessed together by one molecule; no assembled graph paths or cross-molecule end pairing. Partition exact corrected chains,complete-linkage end clusters diameter<=25nt; choose observed molecule nearest both medoids,not longest read. Partial reads add support without moving ends/adding exons. Terminal variants need independently complete endpoints. Monoexonic models never merge by overlap and require both ends,>=3units/2libraries,cap support and>=2tails. Named assembler/collapse defaults do not guarantee this invariant.

nodes.label: Orthogonal chain endpoints and allowed uses
nodes.norm_label: orthogonal chain endpoints and allowed uses
nodes.summary: An IC chain can provide chain evidence independently of ORF/end completeness;IP only subchain,IM monoexon blocks,mapping_ambiguous family-level only with no C2/GSF. Complete ORF models train only from non-held-out training species;test or validation-only models never train. Proposed chain objective is inactive in this revision;noncoding GSF would require out-of-scope format change.

nodes.label: Prealignment triage does not set eligibility
nodes.norm_label: prealignment triage does not set eligibility

FLNC primer presence does not prove ORF completeness; tags never define eligibility,tiers or denominators.

nodes.label: Read completeness and molecule thresholds
